authors: S. J. Berl, C. A. Sackett, T. F. Gallagher, J. Nunkaew
title: Core polarizability of rubidium using spectroscopy of the ng to nh, ni Rydberg transitions
method: microwave and rf multiphoton spectroscopy in a thermal Rb beam, nf5/2 excited by pulsed dye lasers 5s1/2 -> 6p1/2, spontaneous decay to 4d3/2, then 4d3/2 -> nf5/2; extrapolation to zero power
uncertainty: per-interval, 0.2-1.8 MHz (statistical plus 0.1 V/cm stray field and Zeeman shift in quadrature)
conversion: Not exported, intervals from a reference that is no single level: 9 rows (17fcg-17gcg, 17fcg-17hcg, 17fcg-17icg, 18fcg-18gcg, 18fcg-18hcg, 18fcg-18icg, 19fcg-19gcg, 19fcg-19hcg, ...).
caveats: cg columns derived from measured columns (correlated)
